subject: Re: Org restructure proposal: Inference Platform — finalizing scope & comms
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Org restructure proposal: Inference Platform teams

Team —

Following our Q1 capacity and performance review, attached is an initial proposal to re-align the Inference Platform org to reduce cross-team handoffs and clarify ownership for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. High-level goals:

- Reduce operational friction between Serving Runtime and Deployment Orchestration by creating clearer ownership for model lifecycle and rollout policy enforcement.
- Improve SLAs and escalation paths for Dedicated customers by consolidating the Dedicated account engineering remit.
- Create a small cross-cutting "Platform Integrations" squad to own SDK/Console surface area and telemetry.

Attachments: org-chart-v2.pptx (high-level team map), reorg-onepager.pdf (rationale + metrics).

Asks: please review and reply with at least: (1) any redlines to reporting lines, (2) concerns about headcount/IC scope shifts, (3) suggested changes to the comms plan for customers.

I scheduled a 30-min sync on Wednesday to go through major points — if you can't make it, reply here or drop comments directly in the Drive folder.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: org-chart-v2.pptx (pptx, 2.3MB)]
[Attachment: reorg-onepager.pdf (pdf, 420KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org restructure proposal: Inference Platform teams

Evelyn — thanks for the deck and one-pager. Quick notes inline and top-level: 

- Reporting lines: moving the Dedicated account engineers under a single Dedicated Lead makes sense for faster escalation, but we should keep dotted-line to Reliability for postmortems. Concern: we may create a gap for long-tail performance tuning work if we remove Embedded Runtime owners from Serving Runtime.

- Headcount: current plan assumes 4 FTEs reallocated from Runtime to Platform Integrations; I think we should make that 3 + 1 contractor for Q3 to preserve critical kernel work.

- Comms: customers on active Dedicated contracts should get a personalized outreach; I'd like Legal and CS to review the wording.

I'll add comments in the Drive deck. See below for one quick addition to the org-chart: add a senior engineering manager slot under Platform Integrations for SDK ownership.

Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org restructure proposal: Inference Platform teams

Evelyn / Marissa — good framing. Customer signal perspective: Dedicated customers care most about a single point of contact for incidents and predictable performance improvements. If Dedicated gets its own Lead, we should ensure that account-level SLAs and the roadmap for Dedicated features (burst capacity, private VPN integrations) are explicitly tracked.

Request: before we finalize communications, can we have a short note for customers that explains: (a) who their new operational contact will be, (b) what changes (if any) affect billing or support windows, and (c) where to direct urgent escalations? I can share that with Acme — James is watching closely.

Also, small ask: please confirm whether this reorg preserves the current escalation path to Platform Reliability for Sev2/3s.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org restructure proposal: Inference Platform — finalizing scope & comms

Team / PeopleOps —

Thanks for the quick feedback. Based on Marissa and Aditya's input I've made three concrete updates:

1) Reporting lines: Dedicated Lead will own day-to-day account engineering and incident ownership; dotted-line to Platform Reliability for postmortems and long-term performance work.
2) Headcount: we will move 3 FTEs from Serving Runtime into Platform Integrations and hire 1 contractor for Q3 kernel backlog. I'll ask Recruiting to open the manager role for SDK/Console ownership.
3) Comms: attached is a draft customer-facing note (org-comm-draft.md) and a recommended cadence for personalized outreach to active Dedicated customers; Aditya — please review before I share with James.

Next steps: Lauren, can you take Exec approval and Legal review this week? PeopleOps, please attach any suggested wording edits (tone and change-management checklist). I plan to publish the public internal announcement the week after approvals and run a team-level Q&A for impacted ICs.

Drive folder with live comments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-inference-reorg
Notion playbook draft: https://notion.redwood.com/Inference-Reorg-Playbook

Attachments: org-comm-draft.md (customer + internal comm templates).

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
